name: get_domain_order
description: Get the status of a domain purchase order returned by buy_domain, to confirm whether the registration completed.

teamId.description:
The ID or slug of the team that owns the resource.
Team IDs start with "team_".
If you do not know the team ID or slug, it can be found through these mechanism:
- Read the file .vercel/project.json if it exists and extract the orgId
- Use the `list_teams` tool
